notes: Race: Sheinbaum's share of the Sheinbaum + Gálvez votes (two-way); she wins this market's event when it exceeds 50% (Máynez, third, could not win). Final = official cómputos (INE): 68.52% two-way (59.76% of all votes cast).
counted = the model's share of the expected two-way votes already counted (timeline); map f = share of the district's expected actas (polling-station tally sheets) counted.

Count path rebuilt from each acta's PREP verification time: an acta is shown from the first 5-minute PREP cut that held it, 5 minutes after the cut's label (checked against archived cut files: docs/mexico.md). PREP opened at 20:00 central time (02:00 UTC) and stopped at 93.2% of actas; the rest entered only the official cómputo days later.

Model: brunder.nowcast on 70,537 electoral sections (state = region), prior = 2018 cómputos by section (López Obrador vs Anaya + Meade), tau = 0.01, every setting chosen on the 2018 count and set in configs/mx2024_v1.toml. Evidence: not pre-registered: settings chosen on the 2018 count only (configs/mx2024_dev_2018.toml), but configs/mx2024_v1.toml was first committed after scoring, and one exploratory run on the 2024 count (tau = 0.015, 30-minute ticks) was looked at before the config was frozen; outcome long known. The map shows the section projections summed to the 300 federal districts.
Polymarket was already >= 0.9 on Sheinbaum from 2024-06-01 00:05 UTC, two days before the count; the markets closed at 12:46-12:56 UTC on 3 June (Gamma closedTime), so pm is empty after that.

Accuracy: projected share minus final at 1/5/10/25/50% counted: 1% +1.9 (raw -0.3), 5% +0.4 (raw -1.6), 10% -0.6 (raw -2.5), 25% -1.5 (raw -2.9), 50% -1.6 (raw -2.2) points. The 90% intervals held the final share in 10% of minutes (1-95% counted): far too narrow.
Profit: the frozen Brazil rule (favoured side, edge >= 5c after costs, >= 1% counted) found no signal in either market, so there is nothing to fill.
pm = Polymarket price of the YES (= Sheinbaum) side, carried forward minute by minute. No Kalshi data.

v2 (sensitivity, chosen after the result was known): v1 chose tau on the 2018 night alone and its 90% band held the final share in 10% of minutes. v2 applies a rule written beforehand to the 2012 (IFE PREP database, prior 2006 cómputos) and 2018 nights: smallest tau with pooled 90% coverage >= 0.90 and worst night >= 0.75, then the (rho, kappa) of lowest projection error: tau 0.015, rho 1.0, kappa 10,000 (configs/mx2024_v2.toml). On 2024 the band held 14% of minutes against the cómputo and 81% against the end-of-PREP share (v1: 40%). The PREP stops at 93.2% of actas and differs from the cómputo (end-of-PREP raw share 68.02% vs cómputo 68.52%). v1 stays the headline.

sensitivity.label: v2: settings from the 2012 and 2018 nights (tau 0.015, rho 1.0, kappa 10,000; chosen after the result was known, sensitivity)

sensitivities.label: tau mixture over earlier nights (chosen after the result was known)
sensitivities.note: An equal-weight mixture over the reporting-order errors that 4 earlier count nights needed (mx2012 0.015, mx2018 0.02, br2022r1 0, br2022r2 0.005). Same point forecast as the base model (rho 0.8, kappa 50,000); only the band and the win chance allow for those 4 different errors instead of one. Built from earlier nights only, but chosen after this result was known, so it is a sensitivity, not a forecast.
